notes: A model change re-picks the thread's account fresh, and the pick lands the moment a model is chosen. routeFor/expectAccount take { fresh } (chooseAccount with no sticky current): a thread that changes model takes the best account for the new model instead of staying wherever it was while that account still had room (the prompt cache is per model, so staying kept nothing). session.tune accepts model: the composer's pick sends the native id with fast/1M for a same-provider model, the registry persists it, re-picks the account at once and drops the handle (deferred to settle mid-turn, like setThreadRules, so the stream is not cut); a model of another provider still waits for the send's harness switch.
